The affected Windows Wheel.install_as_egg -> _fix_namespace_packages legacy installer is never used by the service. Both bootstrap entrypoints install hash-verified locks through the standalone uv executable, not setuptools legacy wheel installation. Runtime does not accept or install wheel files. Setuptools 81.0.0 is retained only in model environments because Torch 2.11 requires <82; API/tool environments do not receive this exception.

TIFF/EXIF overlapping-tag IFD parsing is unreachable in these model runtimes: ASR/aligner/TTS accept local audio, Gradio is not served, and video paths consume PyAV-decoded RGB pixels without Pillow Image.open/getexif/EXIF parsing. JPEG output carries no EXIF/tiffinfo metadata. API image readers already use patched Pillow 13.0.0. This is a bounded non-reachability assessment, not a Pillow package fix.

libtiff TIFF encoding with inherited or caller-supplied image geometry/EXIF tags is unreachable in these model runtimes: video output is only JPEG from decoded RGB pixels without exif/tiffinfo/ICC/comment metadata, audio inference receives no images, and Gradio is not served. API already uses patched Pillow 13.0.0. The image/EXIF parsing and JPEG-only metadata boundaries are regression-tested. This is not a Pillow package fix.
